_meta.description: PokéSurvivor 世界地圖結構化數據。欄位 _src 為 .cache/app.pretty.js 的行號（格式 app.pretty.js:行號 或 行號-行號）。

biomeCycle.runClock: run 計時 o，於 playing 狀態以 dt 累加；單幀 dt = min(1/30, 實際間隔) × L（L = 1）

arenaBiomeFormula.formula: 3 + max(0, index of theme in ARENA_TYPES)

biomeMusic.biomeChangeMusic: 程式碼未明確：生態區切換時只播放 sfx biome，未呼叫 music()

outerWorld.liquid: p(x/13, y/13, seed+101) < 0.04 + 0.23 * n → liquid (type = current biome liquid)
outerWorld.wall: else p(x/8, y/8, seed+202) > 1 - 0.27 * n → wall; else floor
outerWorld.density: 程式碼未明確（實際比例取決於雜訊分布）

arena.corridor: (|dx| <= 2 and dy in [-6,5]) or hypot < 2.5 → floor, no props
arena.pillars: distance < r - 2 and noise(x>>1, y>>1, seed+31+tx) < theme.pillars → wall
arena.pools: distance < r - 1.5 and noise(x/3.2, y/3.2, seed+37+tx) < theme.pools → liquid

terrain.walkable: wall: no. liquid with dmg (lava/poison/spark): no for all. water/swamp/ice: yes. solid props block.

typeEffectiveness.stab: 程式碼未見（grep stab/sameType 無結果）

hiddenTraitNote.text: 程式碼未見名為『隱藏特性』的屬性機制。G.TRAIT_TEXT 為寶可夢個性描述。

propsSpawnOuterWorld.eligible: tile is floor AND hypot(x,y) >= 7 AND not in broken-set (y)
propsSpawnOuterWorld.specialRule: 3x3 all floor AND hypot > 12 AND f < 0.0032 (f = hash(x,y,909))

tree.rule: 3x3 floor AND l < 0.07 (forest patch: p(x/10,y/10,seed+505) > 0.6) else l < 0.006

grass.ratePerEligibleTile: 0.75 inside grass-noise regions; region share 程式碼未明確

propsSpawnOuterWorld.precedence: special roll first; if not special then tree/rock/chest/grass chain

propsSpawnArena.zone: distance < r + 9 (r = 11): arena branch replaces outer rules; props only if distance < r - 1.2 and not corridor

rules.rock: 3x3 floor AND theme.props.tree <= hash(777) < tree + rock

rock.roll: single Math.random() = e (outcomes are not exclusive for e > 0.94)

altar.activation: not used AND player alive AND dist2 < max(30, 9 + player.r + 14)^2 (player.r = bodyRadius(dex), species-dependent)

spring.heal: hp = min(maxHp, hp + 0.14 * maxHp * dt) while charge > 0.02 and hp < maxHp and alive
spring.drain: charge -= 0.09 * dt during heal (from full: about 10.9 s)
spring.dryMessage: El manantial se ha secado (se recarga solo)

bigchest.decay: out of range or dead: open = max(0, open - 1.5 * dt)

trap.trigger: player alive and dist2 < 169 (13 px) from (x, y-8), OR host and a non-flying non-remote enemy within radius 3

powers.descZh: 從遠處吸引所有拾取物

powerRules.oneAtATime: addPower: if a power is active its off() runs, then the new on(); no stacking
powerRules.timer: power.t -= dt; at <= 0 off() and power = null

kinds.hintEs: el Fuego se potencia y el Agua se debilita
kinds.hintZh: 火屬性增強，水屬性減弱

kinds.hintEs: el Agua se potencia y el Fuego se debilita
kinds.hintZh: 水屬性增強，火屬性減弱

kinds.hintEs: Roca, Tierra y Acero se potencian; el resto sufre
kinds.hintZh: 岩石、地面、鋼屬性增強；其餘屬性受傷

kinds.hintEs: el Hielo se potencia; el resto sufre y va más lento
kinds.hintZh: 冰屬性增強；其餘屬性受傷且移動變慢

kinds.hintEs: Fantasma, Hada y Psíquico se potencian
kinds.hintZh: 幽靈、妖精、超能力屬性增強

schedule.selection: table = e[biomeIndex % 3]; weighted random over weights (unnormalised); fallback 'rain'

trigger.conditions: host or solo AND elapsed > 120 s AND no active weather AND not in arena
trigger.timer: 60 s, decreases only when conditions hold; at <= 0: reset 60 and roll

enemyTick.condition: kind has safe list AND intensity > 0.5
enemyTick.targets: non-dead, non-remote, non-boss enemies with hurting types

damage.hurtsRule: hurts(types) = kind has safe AND no type in safe

speed.rule: if kind.slow AND types do not include ice: speed *= 1 - 0.1 * intensity

visibility.fogVignette: vignette = intensity for fog, else 0 (radial gradient overlay)
visibility.viewDistance: 程式碼未明確（未找到改變視野距離的設定）

weather.messages: start banner: name + ': ' + hint, 3.4 s, sfx biome

beam.hit: along-axis in [-R, len + R] and |across| <= w/2 + 0.6 * R

hazards.damage: player.invuln = 0; player.hurt(dmg, type); final = dmg * Types.mult(type) * Weather.mult(type); only the local player is damaged

sources.trigger: fuse starts when distance < enemy.r + target.r + 26

spawnRoll.gate: no marker, no arena, boss not alive
spawnRoll.chance: 0.2 * (1 + failures); failures reset on success (20/40/60/80/100%, no cap)

marker.placement: anchor = random alive participant (or player); 24 tries: angle random, distance rand(380,560) px, y * 0.85; accept first with isFree(x,y,22)
marker.activation: player dist2 < 900 (30 px) from (x, y-10) and not yet activated

legendPool.source: G.DEX entries with leg flag AND SPRITE_META present
legendPool.weight: 1 if already recorded in save.legends, else 4

arenaObject.type: argument or uniform pick from legend species types

boss.behavior: ranged if types include psychic/electric/ghost/fairy/fire/water/ice/dragon else charger
boss.where: spawned at (arena.x, arena.y - 3.5 * 32), legend = true, flying = false
boss.T: run seconds; s = late(T) = exp(min(30, 374e-6 * max(0, T/60 - 60)^2))

defeat.condition: all participants dead for > 1.4 s, or arena time > 120 s

enemyClamp.note: non-remote enemies are projected to radius (r - 1.4) * 32 = 307.2 px around the center during the fight

spawnerFrozen.note: Spawner.update returns while arena is active

enemySpawn.rate: h(t) = 0.24 * (1.6 + 0.028 * t + 0.5 * (t/60)^1.6) per second, t = run seconds
enemySpawn.poolSelection: bagAt(t): every pool with from <= t contributes each species with weight 10 (3 if t - from > 260); uniform pick
enemySpawn.biomeDependence: none: spawner and enemy selection never read biome or tiles (grep 82955-83234 and 88785-88906)
